answer: Adopt a verifiable sampling lottery with refundable bonded tickets: 1) each applicant locks 25 USDC into a per-epoch ticket contract; 2) a verifiable random function draws winners, one per vertex of a duplicate-proofing graph, so no wallet wins twice; 3) losers get refunds, winners keep a slot plus a pool share; 4) the ticket pool forms a prism, refracting equal stakes into random slots. Filling 50 slots at 1-in-1,000 odds needs 50,000 tickets, about 1,250,000 USDC locked, and 50,000 separate liveness devices. Like a lotus pod: thousands of seeds, a few germinate.
